name: stormwind_stockade
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 34 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json). The boss order is the usual clear order, the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss; walls, doors, stairs and events are unknown to it. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.
No instance script in the core; the map is small and linear. No inside teleport row of its own.

Pack sizes, Stormwind Stockade (2026-10-22, from the world export of map 34, no live run; ~/TortoiseBots-audit/PREP-STOCKADE-2026-10-22.md): the trash is all humanoid elite (Prisoner 1706, Captive 1707, Inmate 1708, Convict 1711, Insurgent 1715), every one of them and Dextren, Kam and Bazil flee at 15 % health (EventAI), hence fleers; the stunners and the Kicker (Convict, Insurgent: Backhand and Shield Slam; Prisoner: Kick) are the cc_priority entries, the Convict is cc_always, none of the trash is immune to Polymorph. Hamhock (1717) is the only caster on the map (Chain Lightning, interruptible, and Bloodlust), so he is the kill_first entry of the one fight where he stands with his guards. Every unit has a sight of 20 yd and a call for help of 5 yd (with the 5 yd wander of half of them, units chain at about 10 yd), and no unit patrols (wander 5 yd on 45 of 93). The pull radii are cut to the group's own members (farthest member plus its wander) so that a neighbouring pack, the rare Bruegal or a boss is not counted as a joiner; the packs that stand with a boss are the boss's first, not pulls.

legs.name: targorr_the_dread
notes: Bruegal Ironknuckle (1720, a rare elite, 2250 hp, stands still) is 5.7 yd from the Inmate at 159.9 40.0 and 8.4 yd from the Inmate at 161.1 54.0, and units chain at about 10 yd (call for help 5 yd plus wander 5 yd), so the block east of the lower floor cannot be pulled without him: he is a member of pull group 10 (with the Inmate, the Prisoner and the Inmate west of him; radius 11) and is fought on purpose. The pack that follows is split in two pairs (radius 9 each), which the old group of four with radius 19 pulled in one go together with him.

Targorr the Dread (1696) stands 6 yd from the Captive at 153.7 3.7 and the Prisoner at 165.9 1.1, 3 units chain at 10 yd: they are the boss's first (Prisoner, then Captive), not two pulls that are the boss fight. Pull group 4 (127 -1, 131 3, 140 3) is 19 yd from Targorr, inside his 20 yd sight if the party stands east of x 134: not changed here, the stand wants the mapping walk. Targorr enrages at 30 % (EventAI).

Radii: group 0 was 20.7 and took the Prisoner of group 1 (15 yd from its centre), now 13; group 8 was 18.8 and took the Captive of the upper floor (z -26, 17 yd), now 14. Not changed: the ledge stand of group 8 (plan-check detour: 39 yd direct, 113 yd on foot) and the backtrack over the lower floor packs (leg 1 walks the same ramp again).

legs.name: dextren_ward
notes: Dextren Ward (1663) stands in a creature_group with the Inmate 79114 and the Prisoner 79115 (flags 2, they aggro together; the old pull group 5): they are his first (Prisoner, then Inmate), not a pull in front of him. The three Inmates at 171 142 (the last pull group) stand 8-14 yd from him and units chain at about 10 yd, so pulling them wakes him and his guards: 6 units, radius cut from 14.9 to 7. They are pulled last (after the west pack and the east pack) so that nothing else is left to be run into. Dextren's Intimidating Shout (19134, fear, instant, cannot be interrupted) scatters the party for a few seconds: with the rest of the leg dead the fear runs into the cell the fight is in and not into the packs of 148 106 (27 yd) or 123 122 (43 yd). He flees at 15 % health.

The pack order of the leg is now 0-4, west (120-130 119-129), east (171-193 86-95), the Inmates, boss; before it was 0-4, the guards, the Inmates, west, east, boss, which walked past Dextren's cell twice.

legs.name: kam_deepfury
notes: Kam Deepfury (1666) stands 8 yd from the Insurgent at 140.2 -64.5 and 9 yd from the two Inmates at 152.8 -69.5 and 150.3 -76.8; four units chain at 10 yd: the three are his first (Insurgent, then the Inmates), not two pulls. The packs that stand 18-24 yd from him (group 5 at 124 -66, the Convict at 155 -52 and the block of four at 129-147 -36..-48) are inside his 20 yd sight if the party stands near, and are now pulled before the boss (the Convict and the block of four used to come after the pulls at his feet). Kam flees at 15 % health, towards the block of four.

Radii: group 0 was 14.2 and took the Insurgent and the Convict one floor down (z -34.8, 11-13 yd from its centre), now 10; group 1 was 10 and took the Captive of group 0 (9 yd), now 7; group 3 was 15.8 and took the Insurgent of group 4 (15 yd), now 12; group 5 was 14.7 and took it too (13 yd), now 11; the block of four was 21.1 and took the Inmate of group 2 (18 yd) and the Convict (21 yd), now 17. Not changed: the ledge stand of group 3 (plan-check detour: 29 yd direct, 124 yd on foot), the lower floor approach of group 1, and the Captive at 87.7 -29.0 pulled last, 20 approach rows from the start of the leg.

legs.name: hamhock
notes: Hamhock (1717) stands in a creature_group with the Insurgents 79099 and 79101 (flags 2, aggro together, 10 yd and 9 yd from him); the old pull group 1 of the two Insurgents was the boss fight. It is gone and the guards come with the boss: they are not the boss's first because the first of a boss row is every unit of the entry within 30 yd of him, and the Insurgent of Bazil's pair (91.8 -126.0) stands 24 yd from Hamhock. The other two packs are pulled first (they used to come after the boss, 30 and 70 yd away, which walked the party out and back). Hamhock casts Chain Lightning (421, with a cast time, the core can interrupt it) and Bloodlust (6742, instant): he is the plan's kill_first and has the interrupt tactic. The run leader's rows carry neither tactic (no ai_boss_tactic row for map 34 yet).

legs.name: bazil_thredd
notes: Bazil Thredd (1716) stands 10 yd from the Insurgent at 91.8 -126.0 and the Convict at 95.4 -128.7 (chain of 3 at 10 yd): the pair is his first (Insurgent, then Convict), not a pull. The leg began on the Insurgent's own spawn; it now begins on Hamhock's spot (105.5 -105.8), 35 yd from Bazil and 24 yd from the pair, which is outside their 20 yd sight. Bazil flees at 15 % health; Smoke Bomb (7964) blinds.
